props.current: Truck Country comes to Chicagoland with new Hampshire location

props.text: HAMPSHIRE, Ill. – Chicagoland is now Truck Country.
On July 16, Truck Country, the largest Freightliner dealership group in the United States, recently welcomed customers its North Chicago location, with the opening of its Hampshire, Ill. location.

Truck Country – North Chicago is located at 205 Metrix Drive, and is conveniently situated near Interstate 90 and Highway 20. (To access the dealership, please use Exit 42 off of Interstate 90.) The 65,000-square-foot
location features 26 service bays, as well as an extensive trucks and parts inventory. Approximately 60 people are employed at the Hampshire dealership.

The North Chicago location is the Truck Country dealership group’s 25th dealership in Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Ohio, Wisconsin, and now Illinois. (Dealerships in Indiana and Ohio operate under the name of Stoops Freightliner-Quality Trailer.)

Truck Country is part of the family-owned McCoy Group. Now under the leadership of the third generation of members of the McCoy family, the McCoy Group has over 60 years of experience in the transportation industry.

“We are excited to open our newest location in Chicagoland,” Truck Country Vice President of Operations Dan Armstrong said. “We look forward to serving our customers in Illinois with the same hard work and dedication for which Truck Country has long been known.”
